hero.subtitle: SafeMe replaces scattered social media posts with verified, geolocated alerts sent to the people who are actually nearby.

why.title: Social media shares.
why.text: A WhatsApp post comes from a good place, but it exposes families to scammers and gets lost in the feed. SafeMe keeps the community's energy and removes the danger.

verified.title: Every alert is verified
verified.text: A moderator checks each alert before it goes public: no more hoaxes or false information.

masked.title: Protected number
masked.text: Contact goes through the app. The parents' phone number is never shown.

nearby.title: Neighbours first
nearby.text: People close to the last known place are alerted first, then the radius grows.

timeline.title: Sightings on a map
timeline.text: Every "I saw this child" is timed, located and visible to the family and authorities.

how.title: From the alert to the first sighting, in minutes

steps.title: The parent reports
steps.text: Photo, description, last place and time the child was seen.

steps.title: A moderator verifies
steps.text: The alert is checked before it goes public, to stop false information.

steps.title: Neighbours are alerted
steps.text: Nearby users get the alert, and the radius grows over time.

steps.title: Sightings come in
steps.text: Every "I saw this child" appears live on the family's map.

modules.title: Protecting people, and what belongs to them

children.title: Missing children
children.text: A verified, geolocated alert system, built for the first hours, the ones that matter most.

documents.title: Found documents
documents.text: An ID card, a passport, a diploma? Help its owner get it back safely.

tracker.title: A tracker to watch over the little ones
tracker.text: A small ESP32 device sends the child's location. Parents set safe zones, and an SOS button triggers an alert instantly.

features.title: Safe zones
features.text: Home, school: a notification as soon as the child leaves.

features.title: SOS button
features.text: One press, and the parent gets the alert with the exact location.

features.title: Live location
features.text: The route shows on the map, visible only to the family.

device.name: Amina's tracker
device.mapLabel: Map of the route from home to school, inside the safe zone

ai.title: Smart help when every minute counts

items.title: Assistant for parents
items.text: A step-by-step guide, in French or English, to fill in a complete alert.

items.title: Poster generator
items.text: A bilingual poster with a QR code, ready to share on WhatsApp.

items.title: Sighting analysis
items.text: Groups sightings by place and time to guide the search.

chat.question: My son didn't come home from school, what should I do?
chat.answer: Let's stay calm. Tell me the time and place he was last seen, and I'll prepare the alert with you.

cta.title: Every minute counts.
cta.text: If a child is missing, report it now. If you found a document, help its owner get it back.
cta.emergency: In immediate danger, call the police on 117.

footer.tagline: Together, let's find our children faster.

demo.title: This is what a SafeMe alert looks like
demo.text: A fictional example: the timer runs live, the alert zone shows on the map, and neighbours can report the child in one tap.
